Pehli baar Gulf mein job ka plan hai? Yeh 5 tips pehle padh lo. 📌

1️⃣ CV short aur clear rakho — har application se pehle update karo.
2️⃣ Har job offer verify karo. Koi job ke naam pe paise maange toh savdhaan rahiye.
3️⃣ Documents ready rakho — passport, degree, marksheets, experience letters, aur sabki digital copies.
4️⃣ Seekhte raho — achhi English, thodi Arabic, aur koi naya skill ya certificate.
5️⃣ Akele shuru mat karo — wahan pehle se rehne wale Kokanis se baat karo, sawaal poocho.

Kya aapka bachcha exam pressure mehsoos kar raha hai? 📚 Parents ke liye 6 zaroori baatein:

1️⃣ Stress ke signs pehchaaniye — chidchidapan, bhook na lagna, neend na aana, thakaan.
2️⃣ Bachche ki khushi ko marks se mat jodiye. Khush bachcha behtar perform karta hai.
3️⃣ Guide kijiye, apne sapne thopiye mat. Unke sapnon ka saath dijiye.
4️⃣ Neend zaroori hai. Raat bhar padhne ke liye majboor mat kijiye — thoda walk, cycling ya khel bhi madad karta hai.
5️⃣ Kam marks pe saza mat dijiye. Ek exam mein fail hona, zindagi mein fail hona nahi hai.
6️⃣ Yaad rakhiye: success ek safar hai, ek din ka event nahi.

Sales mein ho? Aapka mindset aapki sales bana bhi sakta hai, bigaad bhi sakta hai. 💼

5 mindset traps — aur unse kaise bachein:

1️⃣ Self-limiting beliefs — goals set karo, feedback maango, har rukaawat ko seekhne ka mauka samjho.
2️⃣ Rejection ka darr — har "no" ek sabak hai. Customer ko jo value de rahe ho, us pe focus karo.
3️⃣ Negative self-talk — apne aap se ek coach ki tarah baat karo. Apni strengths yaad rakho.
4️⃣ Empathy ki kami — dhyan se suno, customer ki nazar se dekho, unki success ki parwaah karo.
5️⃣ Sirf quick deals ka peecha — trust aur respect pe long-term rishte banao.

Mindset + Skillset + Toolset = Selling Set. 🔑

Zyada gehraai se seekhna hai? Zuber Palawkar ki book "Do Epic Sales" padhiye.

"Khana khaya?" 📞❤️

Din bhar ki mehnat ke baad phone bajta hai — aur ghar se wahi sawaal aata hai, roz.

Hum keh dete hain "Haan, sab theek hai"… mushkil dinon mein bhi, taaki unhe fikr na ho. Lekin har call ke saath unki duaayein bhi aati hain — jo hum tak pahunchti hain, hum jahan bhi hon. 🤲

Aaj ghar call kijiye. Kuch kehne ke liye nahi — bas sunne ke liye.

Distance is far. Family is close.

Interview call aaya hai? Mubarak ho! 🎉 Ab tayyari aise kijiye:

1️⃣ Company ko research karo — woh kya karte hain, unke customers kaun hain, aur role ko kya chahiye.
2️⃣ Apna CV line by line jaano — har point pe sawaal aa sakta hai, har ek ke liye ek chhota, sachcha example ready rakho.
3️⃣ Bol ke practice karo — "Tell me about yourself", "Why this job?" — dost ke saamne ya mirror ke saamne, sirf dimaag mein nahi.
4️⃣ Time pe pahuncho — online hai toh camera, mic aur internet pehle check karo; in person hai toh 10 minute pehle pahuncho.
5️⃣ End mein ek achha sawaal poocho — team ke baare mein, ya role mein success kaisi dikhti hai. Phir shukriya kehna mat bhoolo. 🙏

Saal bhar ka intezaar… aur phir woh din aata hai. ✈️🌴

Pardes mein calendar pe ek hi date sabse khaas hoti hai — chhutti ki. Ticket book hota hai, countdown shuru. Sab ke liye gifts, ek suitcase, bahut saari khushiyaan.

Phir raasta coast ki taraf mudta hai — hare pahaad, laal mitti, aur samandar ki pehli hawa. 🌊 Darwaze pe koi pehle se intezaar kar raha hota hai… woh bhi din gin rahe the. ❤️

Kuch din ke liye, sab kuch poora lagta hai.

We leave Kokan. Kokan never leaves us.

Raat ke 2 baje, neend nahi… aur dimaag mein fikr hi fikr? 🌙

Pardes ki zindagi mein kaam, ghar, kharche — sab ki fikr ho jaati hai. Lekin yaad rakhiye:

"Past is past, future is vast, and present doesn't last." ✨

🕰️ Aaj mein jiyo — kal se seekho, lekin aane wale imaginary problems ko yeh pal mat chheenne do.
🤝 Akele mat raho — dost ko call karo, family ke saath baitho. Apne log fikr ke khilaaf sabse badi taaqat hain.
🧠 Apne khayalon pe nazar rakho — negative soch neeche kheenchti hai, positive soch upar uthaati hai.
🤲 Roz thoda mind, body aur soul ke liye — ek walk, thoda exercise, ek sukoon bhari dua.

Khushi ek manzil nahi, ek safar hai. Fikr kam, khushi zyada. ❤️

Agar fikr bahut zyada ho jaaye, toh kisi apne ya doctor se zaroor baat kijiye.
